mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.code AS processId, fd.descriptionName AS descriptionName, CASE WHEN fd.descriptionName IS NOT NULL AND fd.descriptionName <> '' THEN CONCAT(p.code, ' (', fd.descriptionName, ')') ELSE p.code END AS processDisplay FROM process p INNER JOIN process_day pd ON pd.process_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pdl.process_id AS process_id, MIN(d.name) AS descriptionName FROM process_description_link pdl INNER JOIN process_description d ON d.id = pdl.description_id GROUP BY pdl.process_id ) fd ON fd.process_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.category = 'GAME' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pd.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM process_submitted ps WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ps.process_id = p.id AND ps.capture_date = #{captureDate} ) ORDER BY p.code ASC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.code AS processId, p.currency_id AS currencyId, c.code AS currencyCode, p.remove_word AS removeWord, p.replace_word_from AS replaceWordFrom, p.replace_word_to AS replaceWordTo, p.remark AS remark FROM process p LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.id = p.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.id = #{processId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.category = 'GAME' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT d.name FROM process_description_link pdl INNER JOIN process_description d ON d.id = pdl.description_id WHERE pdl.process_id = #{value} ORDER BY d.name ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, category, code, currency_id AS currencyId, remove_word AS removeWord, replace_word_from AS replaceWordFrom, replace_word_to AS replaceWordTo, remark, status, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM process WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND category = 'BANK' AND code = #{code} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO process (tenant_id, category, code, currency_id, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 'BANK', #{code}, #{currencyId}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, process_id AS processId, currency_id AS currencyId, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM data_capture_draft WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_id = #{processId} AND currency_id = #{currencyId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, draft_id AS draftId, row_index AS rowIndex, col_index AS colIndex, cell_value AS cellValue, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM data_capture_draft_cell WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY row_index ASC, col_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_capture_draft (tenant_id, process_id, currency_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{processId}, #{currencyId}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO data_capture_draft_cell (draft_id, row_index, col_index, cell_value, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.draftId}, #{item.rowIndex}, #{item.colIndex}, #{item.cellValue}, NOW())
